title: Audit what exists before making more
statement: Before making more material, audit how much already exists and how good it is, and ask whether the failure is an absence or a fault in what exists.
example: An audit found 18,768 question-set records already on hand while 500 new ones were being planned.
detail: In the AP question work, an audit found 18,768 question-set records already on hand while 500 new ones were being planned, and the lesson kept was to audit existing data before generating new (`icloud-work/ML learnings/decisions_and_pivots_timeline.md`). Adding examples of a missing item type lifted it from 0% to 12%: that fixed the format, but the content still failed, and the hoped-for 80%+ stalled at about 12% (`icloud-work/ML learnings/training_data_journey.md`). A 70k-record plan was cancelled once analysis showed that more data in the same format wouldn't fix the factual failures (`icloud-work/ML learnings/failures_and_false_starts.md`). The audit counted records but didn't check them, and some had wrong dates or sources (`icloud-work/ML learnings/mcq_set_journey.md`). More material can fix an absence; more of the same won't fix a fault in what exists.
against: The fault half was never tested: whether more question-set data would fix the quality problem, or whether the bottleneck was the fabricated attributions in the data, was left unknown (`icloud-work/ML learnings/decisions_and_pivots_timeline.md`, line 127), and a proposed mini-test was answered without being run (`icloud-work/ML learnings/failures_and_false_starts.md`, line 23). The cross-team summary favours volume: "More representative examples of the hardest cases = better coverage of the output space." (`icloud-work/ML learnings/cross_team_learnings_full.md`, line 73). The second example in the recorded lesson is about prompt changes, not more data (`icloud-work/ML learnings/training_data_journey.md`, line 111).

evidence.quote: **The audit finding:** We had been planning to generate 500 new MCQ_SET examples when we already had 18,768+ after combining raft_combined and sft_v6_combined.
Always audit existing data before generating new.

**Lesson:** Before building a bigger dataset, ask: does the failure mode respond to more data? MCQ_SET at 0% responded to adding examples (0%→12%). MCQ at 60% ceiling did NOT respond to more prompt engineering. Different failures need different fixes.
**What we got wrong:** Thought 504 examples would get MCQ_SET to 80%+. Actual ceiling was ~12%. The format problem was solved; the content quality problem wasn't.
Some of the 18,768 MCQ_SET records have slightly wrong dates or sources
Presenting those as new recommendations would still undershoot.
inventory and deduplicate the candidate corpus before making size claims;
